import sys


def solve() -> None:
    a = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    b = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n, m = len(a), len(b)

    # 滚动数组，只需保留上一行
    dp = [0] * (m + 1)
    best = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        prev = 0  # dp[i-1][j-1]
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            cur = dp[j]  # 记录 dp[i-1][j]
            if a[i - 1] == b[j - 1]:
                dp[j] = prev + 1
                best = max(best, dp[j])
            else:
                dp[j] = 0
            prev = cur
    print(best)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
